headline: Hassan Omar Daffa Appointed As The New Chief Kadhi Of Kenya
seoTitle: Hassan Omar Daffa Appointed Chief Kadhi
metaDescription: Hassan Omar Daffa has been appointed as the new Chief Kadhi of Kenya, taking over the role from the late Sheikh Abdul Halim Hussein.
aiSummaryBullets: Hassan Omar Daffa has been formally appointed as the new Chief Kadhi of Kenya.
He previously held the position of Principal Kadhi within the institution.
The appointment follows a recruitment process that commenced with a vacancy advertisement in January 2026.
aiContextParagraph: The Judicial Service Commission has officially named Hassan Omar Daffa as the new Chief Kadhi. This leadership position was left vacant following the passing of the late Sheikh Abdul Halim Hussein. Daffa brings experience to the role, having previously served the judiciary as a Principal Kadhi. The recruitment process for this specific vacancy began on January 16, 2026, when the position was formally advertised to the public. During the selection period, the Judicial Service Commission faced public and institutional scrutiny regarding the duration of the recruitment process and perceived delays in finalizing the appointment. With this announcement, the leadership position of the Chief Kadhi, a key role within the Islamic legal framework of the Kenyan judiciary, has been filled to ensure the continued administration of religious legal matters.
whyItIsViral: The appointment is trending due to significant coverage from two independent news outlets and public interest regarding the previous administrative delays.
